name: Commission 10
definition: Amount of money due to a party as compensation for a service.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Service for which the commission is asked or paid.

ExtendedType.name: Extended Type
ExtendedType.definition: Service for which the commission is asked or paid.

Basis.name: Basis
Basis.definition: Basis upon which a commission is charged, eg, flat fee.

ExtendedBasis.name: Extended Basis
ExtendedBasis.definition: Basis upon which a commission is charged, eg, flat fee.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Commission expressed as an amount of money.

RecipientIdentification.name: Recipient Identification
RecipientIdentification.definition: Party entitled to the amount of money resulting from a commission.

CommercialAgreementReference.name: Commercial Agreement Reference
CommercialAgreementReference.definition: Reference to the agreement established between the fund and another party. This element, amongst others, defines the conditions of the commissions.

WaivingDetails.name: Waiving Details
WaivingDetails.definition: Voluntary non-enforcement of the right to all or part of a commission.

TypeOrExtendedTypeRule.definition: Either Type or ExtendedType may be present, but not both.

BasisOrExtendedBasisRule.definition: Either Basis oe ExtendedBasis may be present but not both.
